# DreamerV3 symlog与two-hot价值编码

## 1. 问题

DreamerV3 symlog与two-hot价值编码：实现下列接口并通过数值、边界和实验检查。

实现跨数量级标量变换与离散支持编码；不训练RSSM、想象策略或Minecraft。two_hot输入已经位于symlog空间，中心由调用者指定。

## 2. 核心公式

$$
\operatorname{symlog}(x)=\operatorname{sign}(x)\ln(1+|x|),\quad \operatorname{symexp}(y)=\operatorname{sign}(y)(e^{|y|}-1),\quad p_i=\frac{b_{i+1}-y}{b_{i+1}-b_i},\quad p_{i+1}=1-p_i.
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

- `symlog(values: Tensor) -> Tensor`
- `symexp(values: Tensor) -> Tensor`
- `two_hot(values: Tensor, bins: Tensor) -> Tensor`

先symlog压缩原始标量，再在相邻两个中心间线性分配质量。编码期望等于裁剪后的变换值；解码时先在变换空间求期望，再symexp。将symexp分别作用于中心后平均不是同一操作。

## 4. 本题约定

symlog/symexp接受非空浮点张量；two_hot values任意非空形状，bins为严格递增一维，长度>=2，同dtype/device。标签固定detach，范围外值夹到端点；输出shape=values.shape+(N,)。

校验辅助函数已提供。浮点输入为有限 CPU float32/float64，不修改输入；非法形状、类型、范围或掩码必须抛出 `ValueError`。

## 5. 交互图与确定性实验

`experiment.py` 在固定输入上调用提交的全部接口，记录学习或采样曲线与末端指标。实验逻辑和阈值见 T3，输出同样用于可视化。

可视化由 `viz/gen.py` 生成；T3 将你的函数传入同一实验并记录真实指标。这是小规模确定性教学实验，不是机器人基准成绩。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 来源与延伸

- [Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.04104) — Symlog predictions and two-hot distribution; Appendix Distributions
- [Verified source](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.04104v2)
- [Verified source](https://github.com/danijar/dreamerv3/blob/main/embodied/jax/outs.py)

核验日期：2026-10-28。扩展到完整论文系统还需要本题范围中明确省略的模型、数据和环境。

## 测试捕获的错误

- Negative rewards lose their sign under symlog.
- Two-hot weights assume uniform spacing even for a nonuniform support.

## 实验范围

实现跨数量级标量变换与离散支持编码；不训练RSSM、想象策略或Minecraft。two_hot输入已经位于symlog空间，中心由调用者指定。

## 可重复实验记录

6个跨数量级标量、25个[-6,6]中心；零logits做150步交叉熵梯度下降(lr=3)。变换往返误差<1e-9，交叉熵<初始40%，最终标签KL<0.1。

判题固定seed=42。计算采用CPU float64、显式输入，涉及优化时使用普通梯度更新；不下载数据集或模型权重。原生PyTorch与真实Pyodide/NumPy-WASM执行同一套T0–T3测试。阈值针对本教学实验。

# DreamerV3 Symlog and Two-Hot Value Encoding

## 1. Exercise goal

DreamerV3 Symlog and Two-Hot Value Encoding: implement the interfaces below and verify numerical, boundary and experimental behavior.

Implement scale-robust scalar transforms and discrete-support encoding; omit the RSSM, imagined policy and Minecraft. two_hot receives values already in symlog space and caller-supplied centers.

## 2. Core equations

$$
\operatorname{symlog}(x)=\operatorname{sign}(x)\ln(1+|x|),\quad \operatorname{symexp}(y)=\operatorname{sign}(y)(e^{|y|}-1),\quad p_i=\frac{b_{i+1}-y}{b_{i+1}-b_i},\quad p_{i+1}=1-p_i.
$$

## 3. From equations to code

- `symlog(values: Tensor) -> Tensor`
- `symexp(values: Tensor) -> Tensor`
- `two_hot(values: Tensor, bins: Tensor) -> Tensor`

Apply symlog to raw scalars, then interpolate mass between adjacent centers. Encoded expectation equals the clipped transformed value. Decode the expectation in transformed space with symexp; averaging symexp of centers is a different operation.

## 4. Contract and boundaries

Symlog/symexp accept nonempty floating tensors. two_hot values have any nonempty shape, bins are strictly increasing 1-D, length>=2, same dtype/device. Labels detach and values outside support clip to endpoints; output shape is values.shape+(N,).

Validation helpers are provided. All floating inputs are finite CPU float32/float64; do not mutate inputs. Invalid shape, dtype, range or mask arguments raise `ValueError`.

## 5. Deterministic experiment and visualization

`experiment.py` calls every submitted interface on fixed inputs and records a learning or sampling curve and terminal metrics. T3 states the behavioral thresholds; the visualization uses the same outputs.

The visualization is generated by `viz/gen.py`; T3 runs the same experiment with your functions and records its actual metrics. These are small deterministic teaching results, not a robot benchmark.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Sources and extensions

- [Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.04104) — Symlog predictions and two-hot distribution; Appendix Distributions
- [Verified source](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.04104v2)
- [Verified source](https://github.com/danijar/dreamerv3/blob/main/embodied/jax/outs.py)

Verified 2026-10-28. Extending this operator to the full paper requires the omitted model, data and environment described in the scope above.

## Mistakes caught by the tests

## Experimental scope

Implement scale-robust scalar transforms and discrete-support encoding; omit the RSSM, imagined policy and Minecraft. two_hot receives values already in symlog space and caller-supplied centers.

Six scalars spanning magnitudes and 25 centers over [-6,6]; zero logits and 150 cross-entropy gradient steps at lr 3. Transform round-trip error <1e-9, cross entropy below 40% of initial and final target KL <.1.
